primaryChecks.text: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
primaryChecks.previousContext: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
primaryChecks.nextContext: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 3:4 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
primaryChecks.previousContext: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;
primaryChecks.nextContext: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 3:5 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:10 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:15 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
primaryChecks.previousContext: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.
primaryChecks.nextContext: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:32 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 8:28 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
primaryChecks.nextContext: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 8:32 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 9:3 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 9:34 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 9:38 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 11:4 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
primaryChecks.previousContext: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
primaryChecks.nextContext: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 14:3 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
primaryChecks.previousContext: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 14:4 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 15:3 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
primaryChecks.nextContext: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 18:7 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 19:15 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 20:1 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.
primaryChecks.nextContext: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 20:3 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 21:4 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 21:15 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
primaryChecks.previousContext: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 21:16 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.
primaryChecks.previousContext: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 23:25 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 28:1 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 29:27 はJerusalemを地理的な対象として明記する。
